extra.reason: Decision: build a custom incremental engine (crate fjfj-engine). Rationale: DICE is not published and tracks Buck2's needs; salsa's single-revision IDE model does not fit thousands of concurrent actions with cancellation. Owning the engine gives control over parallelism, cancellation, Bazel cycle/error semantics, and persistence. Decided by Nathan Howell 2026-09-03.
Decided: all modules in Starlark, no native modules.
Decided by Nathan Howell 2026-09-03: Bazel 9.2.0 is the base compatibility target. --incompatible_* defaults follow 9.2.0; the flag default table is generated from bazel 9.2.0 help flags-as-proto.

Stateright model in crates/fjfj-models/src/publish.rs; exhaustive check passes for fsync-before-rename and finds the truncated-output counterexample without fsync. Lean vocabulary/invariant in spec/Fjfj/Publish.lean. Runs under bazel test //crates/fjfj-models:fjfj-models_test.

Stateright model in crates/fjfj-models/src/scheduler.rs: diamond graph with 2 edits and 1 cancel, cyclic variant, and the mixed-version bug as a switchable flaw. Correct protocol satisfies no-reads-from-the-future, verified-implies-current-deps, quiescence-is-settlement, early cutoff reachable, cycle reported. Flawed protocol produces the counterexample. Invariants stated in spec/Fjfj/Engine.lean.

Stateright model in crates/fjfj-models/src/daemon.rs: two clients, spawn race, daemon and client crashes, idle timeout race, stale lock. Found and encoded the rule that a daemon with blocked clients must not idle out. Negative test: unbroken stale lock wedges clients. Lean vocabulary in spec/Fjfj/Daemon.lean.

spec/Fjfj/ActionKey.lean records canonical-form invariants and the Bazel facts (all inputs executable, CacheSalt, Command.platform repeated). Rust tests in crates/fjfj-remote/src/action_key.rs verify byte parity against Bazel 9.2.0 blobs.
spec/Fjfj/ActionKey.lean; parity tests in fjfj-remote reproduce Bazel 9.2.0 Action/Command bytes.

Answered for the genrule case: fjfj reproduces Bazel 9.2.0 Action and Command bytes and the action digest exactly (crates/fjfj-remote/src/action_key.rs, testdata from --disk_cache + --execution_log_json_file). Findings in docs/design/remote-execution.md. Broader fixtures filed as a follow-up.
Covered by spec/Fjfj/Publish.lean (Safe invariant, init_safe, rename_safe) and the exhaustive Stateright model in crates/fjfj-models/src/publish.rs.
Covered by spec/Fjfj/Daemon.lean (LiveHoldsLock, Serialised, MayIdleOut) and crates/fjfj-models/src/daemon.rs.

Stateright model in crates/fjfj-models/src/dynamic.rs: local/remote race, async cancel racing loser finish, failed branch does not win, atomic claim before publish. Correct protocol satisfies publish-exactly-once, cancelled-never-publishes, failure-does-not-win, quiescence with cleaned scratch; check-then-publish variant double-publishes. Lean rules in spec/Fjfj/Dynamic.lean; design rules in docs/design/sandboxing.md.
